name: Filled Blue Waterskin
summary: Shamans gather water for their trials at the Ruins of Stardust in Ashenvale. The Filled Blue Waterskin carries a pristine sample from the ancient fountain.

sections.title: Sacred Spring of Ashenvale
sections.body: Call of Water initiates cross north from the Barrens into Ashenvale's dense forests. Beyond Lake Mystral, the Ruins of Stardust lie against the mountains dividing Ashenvale from Stonetalon. Fierce forest beasts guard the secluded elven sanctuary. At the center of its lake, an untouched fountain holds water untainted by corruption or drought. A blue waterskin filled from its basin carries the sample sought by shaman masters for ritual attunement.

sections.title: A Rite of Harmony
sections.body: Brine, a hermit and water expert, lives on a hill in the southern Barrens and needs this final sample. He combines it with water from contrasting wells and springs, then distills the pure essence into an offering. The offering can manifest and soothe the elemental spirits of water, completing an initiate's trial.

faq.q: Where is the water gathered to fill this waterskin?
faq.answer: The water comes from a small fountain at the center of the lake in the Ruins of Stardust, in southwestern Ashenvale beyond Lake Mystral.
Brine, a hermit living in the southern Barrens, requires the water for the Call of Water trials he gives novice shaman.

faq.q: What is the purpose of collecting this sample?
aliases: what is filled blue waterskin used for
faq.answer: Brine needs this final sample to brew a draught of extraordinarily pure water, allowing an aspiring shaman to commune with and honor the elemental spirits of water.

faq.q: Is the area where the water is gathered dangerous?
faq.answer: Yes. Hostile wildlife, including local elementals and fierce beasts, inhabit the Ruins of Stardust and defend the ancient elven glade.

angles.text: As a shaman, you gather this water as the final step in mastering water, crossing hostile faction borders to commune with nature's purest reservoirs.
As a Horde initiate, you venture north into Ashenvale's contested woods and ancestral night elven territory to complete sacred rites, facing real danger along the way.
